info.title: Shop API
info.description: Public and customer endpoints used by the store.

get.description: The cart with its lines, their states and the totals, all computed by the API. A customer without a cart gets an empty one with `id: null`, and none is created; an expired cart (180 days after its last change) is empty.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token, also one of the `backoffice` realm (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.summary: Number of units in the cart of the customer
get.description: The counter of the header: the units of every line, in one read and without asking other modules; 0 without a cart.

401.description: Missing or invalid access token, also one of the `backoffice` realm (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

post.summary: Add a product to the cart of the customer
post.description: Adds a line, or adds the units to the line of the product; the first change creates the cart. The product must have a current price and enough available units (the number of units is never told); the cart holds at most 50 products and 99 units of one. Nothing is reserved.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token, also one of the `backoffice` realm (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such product in Catalog (problem details).

409.description: More than 99 units of the product, a 51st product, a product without a current price or available units, or more units than available (problem details with a Polish `detail`).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: A key is missing, of a wrong type, the quantity is out of 1–99 or the product id is not a UUID (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

put.summary: Change the quantity of a line of the cart of the customer
put.description: Sets the quantity. A decrease and the same quantity are always possible; an increase needs a current price and enough available units, like an addition.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON (problem details).

401.description: Missing or invalid access token, also one of the `backoffice` realm (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`).

404.description: No such line, an id that is not a UUID, or an increase of a product Catalog no longer knows (problem details).

409.description: An increase of a product without a current price or available units, or above the available units (problem details with a Polish `detail`).

415.description: The body is not JSON (problem details).

422.description: The quantity is missing, not an integer or out of 1–99 (problem details with `violations`).

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

delete.summary: Remove a line of the cart of the customer
delete.description: Removes the line of the product; a cart without it is answered as it is, a customer without a cart gets the empty one and none is created.

get.description: The whole category tree. Siblings at every level are sorted by name (Polish collation).

200.description: Root categories with their descendants. An empty catalogue gives an empty array.

get.description: A page of products sorted by name, then by id. The category filter includes the products of all its subcategories; an unknown category gives 404, an existing category without products an empty list. A page past the end gives an empty list with the real total.

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

404.description: The `category` filter names a category that does not exist (problem details).

503.description: The search service is unavailable, or a token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without technical details).

get.description: The customer identified by the access token of the `shop` realm.

503.description: The keys of the token issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without detail).

get.description: The availability level of each requested product, for the product list. A product without a stock record, or unknown, is `out_of_stock`. The number of units is never returned. Send the ids as a repeated `productId` key (`?productId=<uuid>&productId=<uuid>`); the `productId[]` form is not accepted. The response may be cached for 60 seconds, so it is not what decides a purchase: the reservation at checkout does.

200.description: The level of every requested product, in the order of the request; a repeated id answers once.

400.description: No id, more than 48 ids, or an id that is not a UUID (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

503.description: A token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without technical details).

get.description: The current gross price of each requested product, for the product list. A product without a price, with a price at an outdated VAT rate, or unknown, is left out. Send the ids as a repeated `productId` key (`?productId=<uuid>&productId=<uuid>`); the `productId[]` form is not accepted. The response may be cached for 60 seconds, so it is not the price to charge: checkout reads prices from the database.

200.description: The prices found, in the order of the request. Possibly an empty list.

400.description: No id, more than 48 ids, or an id that is not a UUID (problem details with `violations`).

401.description: An access token was sent and is invalid (problem details, `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`). No token is needed.

503.description: A token was sent and the keys of its issuer cannot be fetched (problem details without technical details).

total.description: All products matching the filter, not only this page.

image.description: The main image, null when the product has no images.

ProductImage.description: A product image of one predefined size, with signed URLs of its variants grouped by output format.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of every variant, width:height.

variants.description: Variants by output format (the key is the file extension, e.g. webp), widths ascending.

PriceItem.description: The current gross price of one product.

CartView.description: A cart with everything the store shows, computed by the API. The number of available units is never part of it.

id.description: Id of the cart; null for a customer who has no cart yet.

lines.description: The lines in the order they were added.

hasExcludedLines.description: Whether a line is not purchasable and so not part of `totals.gross`.

product.description: Null when Catalog no longer knows the product (`unavailable_product`).

unitPrice.description: The current gross price; null without a current price.

lineTotal.description: Unit price × quantity, only for a `purchasable` line.

state.description: The first that applies: the product is unknown to Catalog, has no current price, has no available unit, has fewer available units than the quantity; otherwise purchasable.

image.description: The main image in the listing size, null when the product has no images.

gross.description: Sum of the purchasable lines in grosze, 0 for an empty cart.

itemCount.description: Units of every line, purchasable or not (the counter in the header).
Units of every line of the cart.

detail.description: Present only for 4xx errors, never for 5xx.

violations.description: Present only for 400 (invalid query parameters) or 422 (invalid request body) caused by invalid input.

title.example: This is not a valid UUID.

AddCartItemRequest.description: A product to add to the cart.

quantity.description: Units to add, from 1 to 99. The line may have at most 99 units.

ChangeCartItemQuantityRequest.description: The new quantity of a line.

MeResponse.description: The customer identified by the access token.

id.description: Customer id, the `sub` of the token.

name.description: Full name, empty when the account has none.

AvailabilityItemResponse.description: The availability level of one product. Never the number of units.

level.description: Availability level computed by the API: no units available, 1 to 5 (last units), or more.

AvailabilityListResponse.description: The availability levels of the requested products.

shop.description: Access token issued by the `shop` realm (customers).
